# Folio

> Folio is a light, focused, native code editor for macOS, built for reading code.

Folio opens local project folders in a quiet, native interface: syntax highlighting
for 60+ languages, side-by-side or stacked split editors, a split or unified Git
diff against HEAD or a branch, line-by-line blame, a project terminal, and just
enough editing — multi-cursor, find & replace, bracket pairing, project-wide
search. It is built with Rust and GPUI: the interface is drawn directly, with no
browser engine. Files are read and written locally — there is no cloud service,
no account, and no AI integration, and the app never uploads project code.

Folio is free for personal, educational, and other noncommercial use, and the
intent is for it to stay free. It is not open-source software; commercial use is
not covered.

## Facts

- Platform: macOS 12 or newer, Apple silicon (M-series)
- Price: free for noncommercial use
- Download: https://folio-website-7j4.pages.dev/download (DMG; auto-updates via Sparkle)
- Source: not publicly available
- Author: xuyi — https://x.com/shizouffa
